services.name: The Ballroom
services.desc: The Third Level Ballroom is beautiful, wide-open event space with an ornate tin ceiling, stunning mahogany fireplace, a huge stained glass window and old-world chandeliers. It can be rented separately, in combination with The Parlor & Portico Deck, or included in The Entire Mansion. Loose Mansion’s third level was originally the Ballroom where Jacob and Ella Loose hosted many elegant evenings in the early 1900’s. The fully restored Ballroom has a wide open floor plan with beautiful hardwood floors.
